description: Defines classes and methods for PRACH detection, including a detector implementation, parameter validation, and noise estimation functions within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: prach_detector_validator_impl
classes.description: Implements a parameter validator for the PRACH detector.

classes.name: prach_detector_generic_impl
classes.description: Implements a simple PRACH detector based on frequency-domain samples, inspired by the generalized log-likelihood ratio detection test.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Validates the PRACH detector configuration parameters.

methods.name: detect
methods.description: Performs PRACH sequence detection from input samples.

methods.name: vector_noise_estimation
methods.description: Estimates and accumulates noise over a detection window.
